name: In Miko We Trust
source:
In Miko We Trust is a freeware fan VN, in which Miko Toyosatomimi takes the world of American politics by storm. Her Vice President is an ordinary, uninteresting high schooler who has no chance to steal her column inches - in other words, you. Traverse the pitfalls of politics and find adventure, danger, and maybe even...love?!

- Be the second in command of America (technically)!
- Serve with the most aggressive Secretary of Defense since the Bush administration!
- Get pestered repeatedly by the director of the CIA!
- Foil a wicked plot to overthrow the government!
- Three different endings (and one bad ending)!
- About 2-3 hours of playtime!
- Miko is the President what else do you want

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=26796]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
《In Miko We Trust》是一款免费同人视觉小说，讲述丰聪耳神子如何在美国政坛掀起风暴。她的副总统是一个普通、无趣、毫无机会抢走媒体版面的高中生——也就是你。穿越政治陷阱，寻找冒险、危险，也许还有……爱情？！

-（严格来说）成为美国的二把手！
-与布什政府以来最激进的国防部长共事！
-反复被CIA局长纠缠！
-挫败推翻政府的邪恶阴谋！
-三种不同结局（以及一个坏结局）！
-游戏时长约2～3小时！
-神子是总统，你还想要什么？

[译自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=26796]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
